start_here: Say to your AI: "Read when my own calendar shows me busy between two times", with {"from":"2030-08-12T00:00:00Z","to":"2030-08-13T00:00:00Z"}. It runs tool:check-when-i-am-busy and answers {"status":"read","busy":[{"start":"2030-08-12T15:00:00.000Z","end":"2030-08-12T16:00:00.000Z"}]}
no_lists_because: It names no list of yours: it takes its input and keeps only its own rows (booking, booking-book) through the records door.
instructions: 1. Say to your AI: "Read when my own calendar shows me busy between two times", and give it from (Start instant, like 2026-08-10T00:00:00Z); to (End instant).
2. The AI calls run_resource_operation at @workshop-tools with method tools:run, tool tool:check-when-i-am-busy and its input (the worked example shows one).
3. Read what comes back: Asks the person's own Google calendar when it is busy between two instants, with the person's own calendar account (the held value calendar-account).
4. It reads and writes only its own rows through the records door: booking (records:list, records:read, records:write); booking-book (records:read, records:write).
